excerpt_i18n.en: In recent years, the XR glasses industry has seemed stuck in an awkward position. On one hand, the industry continuously pursues larger FOV, lighter weight, and more complex AI functional parameters, with rapid iterations of concepts and technical routes, making the entire track feel like an arms race for the "future form." On the other hand, a more practical issue has always loomed: whether users are willing to wear them, or more specifically, willing to wear them long-term. This is also a major reason why the XR glasses industry has not truly seen a large-scale breakout in recent years. "People overestimate the breakout in one or two years but underestimate the underlying transformation over five to ten years." On May 20, during the VITURE Beast new product launch, founder Jiang Gonglue gave a calm assessment to Leiphone. In his view, the XR industry, and even the entire glasses industry, has yet to reach a true consensus. Everyone firmly believes glasses are the next-generation terminal, but no one knows exactly how to reach the endgame. This state of "no consensus" has led different players to offer completely different answers.
